== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''[[Emerald (world)|Emerald]]''' has a solitary primary star.
* It is a red main sequence.

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x4 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x3 [[planetoid belt]]s.
* x4 [[gas giant]]s.
